{{Quote|I am Altah, Handmaiden to Queen Kylantha.|Altah|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Altah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] to [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] tasked a loyal subject of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with safely escorting the handmaiden to the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] so that Palpatine could "apologize" to her.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateEntertainer.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Altah, including one male depiction deemed non-canon in ''Legends'']]
Altah was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> While the [[canon]]ical species of Altah cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity, the quest dialogue identified her as female. Furthermore, while the quest dialogue identified her as Altah, examining the character simply identified her as a "Royal Handmaiden."<ref name="AED" />
